PHILOSOPHY
├── METAPHYSICS ─── what exists? (ontology, substance, causation, time)
├── EPISTEMOLOGY ── how do we know? (justification, skepticism, truth)
├── LOGIC ──────── what follows from what? (validity, inference, formal systems)
├── ETHICS ─────── what should we do? (normative theory, meta-ethics)
├── POLITICAL ───── how should societies be organized?
├── PHILOSOPHY OF MIND ── what is consciousness? (qualia, intentionality)
├── PHILOSOPHY OF LANGUAGE ── how does language mean? (reference, truth)
└── PHILOSOPHY OF SCIENCE ── what makes knowledge scientific?

ANCIENT (600 BCE – 300 CE)
  Pre-Socratics ─────── Plato ──────── Aristotle ──────── Hellenistic Schools
  (Thales, Heraclitus,  (Forms,         (Logic, science,   (Epicureans, Stoics,
   Parmenides, Zeno)     Republic)       Politics)          Skeptics, Cynics)
         |
         v (transmission via Islamic and Byzantine scholars)

MEDIEVAL (300 – 1400 CE)
  Augustine (354–430) ─── Avicenna (980–1037) ─── Aquinas (1225–1274)
  Neo-Platonic                   Islamic                Scholastic synthesis
  Christian theology             rationalism            (Aristotle + Christianity)

EARLY MODERN (1600 – 1750)
  RATIONALISTS                           EMPIRICISTS
  Descartes → Spinoza → Leibniz          Locke → Berkeley → Hume
  (reason = secure foundation)           (experience = only foundation)
         |                                       |
         └───────────────────┬──────────────────┘
                             v

CRITICAL / IDEALIST (1750 – 1850)
  Kant ────── Fichte ────── Schelling ────── Hegel
  (synthesizes  (absolute      (Naturphil.)     (Geist, dialectic,
   rat. + emp.)  subject)                        historical reason)

19TH CENTURY REACTIONS (1820 – 1900)
  Schopenhauer ─── Marx ─── Kierkegaard ─── Nietzsche
  (Will)            (matter)  (existence)     (revaluation of values)

20TH CENTURY
  ANALYTIC TRADITION               CONTINENTAL TRADITION
  Frege → Russell →                Husserl → Heidegger →
  Wittgenstein (TLP) →             Sartre / Camus →
  Vienna Circle →                  Merleau-Ponty →
  Quine → Davidson                 Rawls, Habermas
